fn a() {
    // conformance: freed-port — the child process binds it and the start retries on a taken port
    let p = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port();
}

fn b() {
    let p = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port(); // conformance: freed-port
}

fn c() {
    let p = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port(); // conformance: freed-port — x
}

fn d() {
    let p = TcpListener::bind("127.0.0.1:0").unwrap().local_addr().unwrap().port(); // conformance: freed-port - handed to a child
}
